terrace.note: Authored west lookout; the inner edge joins the plateau. It is not the museum's real entrance or measured terrace.

notes: A 3 m rise, plateau and return to Y0 end about 7 m before the source facade.
Closed convex ground volumes extend below the existing Y0 support; there is no walkable undercroft beneath a thin ramp.
Existing source buildings, road and flat museum entrance remain in place.
The first 90 m and west terrace were checked against source building/barrier footprints; no footprint intersection was found. This is a source snapshot check, not surveyed clearance.
